predecessors.name: Tibetans (Era of Fragmentation)
predecessors.text: Present-day Zanda County, Ngari Prefecture, Tibet Autonomous Region (core area of Guge)

ledger.x: c. 910-912: Kyide Nyimagon flees to Ngari and founds the Guge kingdom; Purang and Guge annexed about 912.
1630: Ladakh conquers Guge; the last king is deported to Ladakh (Ladakh is not on the map).
1630: the kingdom of Guge ends under Ladakhi conquest.

certainty.note: Page gives no frontier or area; core is Zanda County.
